traits.text: Pavement tables under the Anfu Rd plane trees; the corner everyone photographs
traits.textZh: 安福路梧桐树下的路边座，人人都拍的那个转角

traits.text: Half of Anfu Lu walks past with a dog — a room for watching, not working
traits.textZh: 半条安福路牵着狗走过——适合看人，不适合办公

traits.text: Buckwheat galettes are the reason people order a second coffee
traits.textZh: 荞麦可丽饼是让人再点一杯咖啡的理由

headline.en: The plane-tree corner of Anfu Rd, with galettes
headline.zh: 安福路梧桐转角，配荞麦可丽饼

focus.because: pavement tables on the busiest corner of Anfu Rd
focus.becauseZh: 安福路最热闹转角的路边座

traits.text: Glass shed in a 1930s courtyard; the 4pm light is the reason to queue
traits.textZh: 1930年代庭院里的玻璃房，下午四点的光值得排队

traits.text: Only a couple of dozen seats; most people stand in the courtyard
traits.textZh: 座位只有二十来个，多数人站在庭院里

headline.en: A glass box in a Ferguson Lane courtyard at golden hour
headline.zh: 武康庭院里的玻璃盒子，等一束傍晚光
